Methodology, sources and warnings

Source: vignettes/articles/en/methodology.Rmd
methodology.Rmd

How the corpus was built

  1. Text. The 260 PDF files of the Diari de Sessions (5,868 pages) were transcribed with a vision-language OCR model (OvisOCR2) and known errors were cleaned.
  2. Speeches. Each speaker heading opens a new speech. Headings may carry a name (“El Sr. LLUHÍ:”), an office (“El Sr. CONSELLER DE CULTURA:”) or be anonymous (“Un Sr. DIPUTAT:”).
  3. Speaker. Rules applied in order: anonymous headings get no person; “El Sr. PRESIDENT:” is whoever chaired the session at that moment; readings by the secretary get no person; offices are resolved to their holder on that date; ambiguous surnames are resolved with the annotation of the Diari; aliases cover period spellings, homonyms and OCR errors; the rest are matched by surname (exactly or, for OCR errors, by similarity).
  4. Party. party is the 1932 ticket; party_data is the party on the date, taking into account ERC → PNRE (10 October 1933, back to ERC in May 1936) and USC → PSUC (31 July 1936).
  5. Human review. Every case where sources disagree or the assignment is not direct was decided one by one (parl_review_cases()).

Sources

In order of priority when they disagree:

  1. the Diari de Sessions itself;
  2. the Resum de deliberacions 1932–1934, official volume of the Parliament;
  3. the Relació de diputats 1932–1938, leaflet of the Parliament (https://www.parlament.cat/document/intrade/203240);
  4. Wikipedia (in Catalan), mainly for 1936–1938.

Before counting

These choices change the results. Make them explicitly.

Party on the date, not party of the ticket. Use party_data. Lluhí, Selves, Casanelles, Tarradellas and Xirau appear as PNRE between October 1933 and May 1936.

Chairing the session. Speeches by “El Sr. PRESIDENT” are mostly procedure. They are a large share of the corpus:

d <- parl_speeches(text = FALSE)
round(100 * mean(d$resolucio == "presidencia_sessio"), 1)
#> [1] 27.8

Use include_chair = FALSE for analyses of what people say.

Readings by the secretary and anonymous headings. They are excluded by default (spoken_only = TRUE). Readings are documents read aloud, not speeches of the secretary; anonymous headings have no person.

Doubtful attributions. assignacio_dubtosa flags 304 speeches: 201 readings by the secretary, 102 anonymous speeches of “la Majoria” (a coalition led by ERC, assigned to ERC) and one unresolved heading. Use include_doubtful = FALSE to leave them out.

Government and opposition. es_govern is NA before the first statutory government (19 December 1932), during the suspension and when the speech has no party.

table(d$es_govern, useNA = "ifany")
#> 
#> FALSE  TRUE  <NA> 
#> 12527 19056   473

Uneven coverage. 1933 has far more speeches than any other year, and there are almost no sessions in 1937 and 1938. Use rates (parl_trend()) rather than raw counts when comparing periods.

OCR. The text comes from OCR. Searches ignore accents and case by default, but period spellings (e.g. Tarradelles) and residual OCR errors remain.
